title: Steamed Fish Wrap
description: A light and healthy vegetarian meal, perfect for a quick lunch. This steamed fish and wrap recipe is easy to make and packed with nutrients.

ingredients.name: Gentle herbs (such as parsley or basil)
Steamed vegetables (such as broccoli or carrots)

instructions: Steam the fish fillet for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
Wrap the steamed fish in the Dutch wrap.
Add a handful of gentle herbs on top of the fish.
Add a handful of steamed vegetables on top of the herbs.
